info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Ecommerce Cart Taxs-v3-spec
info.description: This API provides access to the tax information for items in the ecommerce cart. It enables developers to retrieve the applicable tax rates based on the current contents of the cart, supporting accurate pricing calculations and compliance with tax regulations. Typical consumers include ecommerce platforms and financial integrations that require up-to-date tax information for transactions. By utilizing this API, businesses can ensure transparency and accuracy in their checkout processes.

get.summary: Retrieve tax information for the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the tax information related to the current shopping cart. This data can help in calculating the total amount due at checkout and ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.

requestBody.description: Request payload for retrieving the tax information for the cart. This payload should adhere to the specified schema and may include necessary parameters for accurate tax calculation, such as cart items and location details.

200.description: Successfully retrieved tax information for the cart.
